author: nickyeow

english.text: December is the last month of the year.

jyutping: sap6 ji6 jyut6 hai6 jat1 nin4 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 go3 jyut6。
text: 十二月係一年嘅最後一個月。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This morning I had a bit of a disagreement with my wife. I didn't think it was a big deal, but seeing what she's like this evening I think I must have upset her.

jyutping: gam1 ziu1 zou2 ngo5 tung4 go3 lou5 po4 jau5 siu2 siu2 aau3 giu6。ngo5 bun2 loi4 ji5 wai4 mou4 mat1 je5，heoi3 dou3 je6 maan5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 ge3 joeng2，sin1 zi1 jyun4 loi4 ngo5 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1。
text: 今朝早我同個老婆有少少拗撬。我本來以為無乜嘢，去到夜晚見到佢咁嘅樣，先知原來我搞到佢好唔開心。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The house in which we lived was torn down.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 zyu6 go2 gaan1 uk1 bei2 jan4 caak3 zo2 laa3。
text: 我哋以前住嗰間屋俾人拆咗喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Last night, he studied all night long.

jyutping: keoi5 cam4 jat6 wan1 zo2 seng4 maan5 syu1。
text: 佢尋日溫咗成晚書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Fighting won't settle anything.

jyutping: daa2 gaau1 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou3 man6 tai4。
text: 打交解決唔到問題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 waan2 jyun4 gaa3 laa3，bei2 faan2 zek3 gaai3 zi2 ngo5 laa1！
text: 我哋已經玩完㗎喇，俾返隻戒指我啦！

author: fercheung

english.text: He likes to watch the birds fly above his head.

jyutping: keoi5 zung1 ji3 tai2 zyu6 di1 zoek3 zai2 hai2 zi6 gei2 tau4 soeng6 fei1 lai4 fei1 heoi3。
text: 佢鍾意睇住啲雀仔喺自己頭上飛嚟飛去。

author: kaenif

english.text: Please stay.

jyutping: cing2 lau4 bou6。
text: 請留步。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom will get killed.
Tom will die.

jyutping: Tom wui5 sei2。
text: Tom會死。

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm here.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 dou6。
text: 我喺度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom was running around the streets drunk and naked.

jyutping: aa3 Tom jam2 zeoi3 zo2，mou5 zoek3 saam1 tung1 gaai1 zau2。
text: 阿Tom飲醉咗，冇著衫通街走。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Good luck on the exam!

jyutping: haau2 si3 gaa1 jau2 aa3！
text: 考試加油呀！

author: nickyeow

english.text: He fell in love with her, but didn't even know her name.

jyutping: keoi5 zung1 ji3 zo2 keoi5，daan6 hai6 lin4 keoi5 giu3 me1 ming4 dou1 m4 zi1。
text: 佢鍾意咗佢，但係連佢叫咩名都唔知。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Is it possible to define the colour red by pointing to an apple?

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zi2 zyu6 nap1 ping4 gwo2 lai4 ding6 ji6 me1 giu3 hung4 sik1？
text: 我可唔可以指住粒蘋果嚟定義咩叫紅色？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sami wanted to protect his family.

jyutping: sam1 mei5 soeng2 bou2 wu6 keoi5 ge3 uk1 kei2 jan4。
text: 森美想保護佢嘅屋企人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm starting to get cold.

jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 ci2 jau5 di1 dung3。
text: 我開始有啲凍。

author: Akh2403

english.text: I'm taller than you.

jyutping: ngo5 gou1 gwo3 nei5。
text: 我高過你。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom is the one who won the prize.

jyutping: lo2 zoeng2 go2 go3 hai6 aa3 tong1。
text: 攞獎嗰個係阿湯。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Don't make fun of children.

jyutping: m4 hou2 siu3 siu2 pang4 jau5。
text: 唔好笑小朋友。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "I've just come out of jail and I want to go see Mom." "Mom?" "Yeah." "Fuck you, dude! Mom died four months ago." "No shit!" "You haven't even heard about that." "It's all your fault! You never wrote. You never visited. How could I have known about that?" "You know what? Just fuck off and never call me again. You and I no longer have anything in common. You're on your own now. Just leave me alone."

jyutping: 「ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 juk6，soeng2 heoi3 gin3 maa1 mi4。」「hai6 aa3。」「diu2 nei5 lou5 mou2！aa3 maa1 sei3 go3 jyut6 cin4 sei2 zo2。」「m4 hou2 zoi3 ngap1 fai3 waa6！」「nei5 lin4 ne1 gin6 si6 dou1 mei6 teng1 gwo3。」「cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 nei5 ge3 co3！nei5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mou5 se2 gwo3 je5。nei5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mou5 heoi3 gwo3 taam3 fong2。ngo5 dim2 wui5 zi1 dou6 ne1 gin6 si6 ne1？」「nei5 zi1 m4 zi1？diu2 nei5 lou5 mou2，m4 hou2 zoi3 daa2 bei2 ngo5。nei5 tung4 ngo5 ji5 ging1 mou5 jam6 ho4 gung6 tung1 dim2。nei5 ji4 gaa1 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3。lau4 dai1 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4。」
text: 「我啱啱出獄，想去見媽咪。」「係呀。」「屌你老母！阿媽四個月前死咗。」「唔好再噏廢話！」「你連呢件事都未聽過。」「全部都係你嘅錯！你從來都冇寫過嘢。你從來都冇去過探訪。我點會知道呢件事呢？」「你知唔知？屌你老母，唔好再打畀我。你同我已經冇任何共通點。你而家自己一個。留低我一個人。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: “You’ve got to have strong electric to have strong water and wastewater and broadband,” DiLoreto says. “You’ve got to have a strong road system if you're going to feed your ports. You’ve got to have strong ports if you're going to ship your goods and get your goods into this country. And, without the roads to support that, what happens when [goods] wind up on the ports and can’t go anywhere [because] congestion is a problem?”

jyutping: 「nei5 jiu3 jau5 koeng4 daai6 ge3 din6 lik6，sin1 ho2 ji5 jau5 koeng4 daai6 ge3 seoi2、fai3 seoi2 tung4 fun1 pan4，」dik6 lok6 leoi4 tok3 waa6。「jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jiu3 wai6 nei5 ge3 gong2 hau2 gung1 seoi2，nei5 zau6 jiu3 jau5 koeng4 daai6 ge3 dou6 lou6 hai6 tung2。jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jiu3 wan6 sung3 nei5 ge3 fo3 mat6 tung4 maai4 zoeng1 nei5 ge3 fo3 mat6 sung3 jap6 ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1，nei5 zau6 jiu3 jau5 koeng4 daai6 ge3 gong2 hau2。ji4 ce2，jyu4 gwo2 mou5 dou6 lou6 heoi3 zi1 wun4 ni1 go3 cing4 fong3，dong1［fo3 mat6］hai2 jam6 ho4 dei6 fong1 dou1 ceot1 jin6 m4 dou3 man6 tai4，gam2 wui6 faat3 saang1 me1 si6？」
text: 「你要有強大嘅電力，先可以有強大嘅水、廢水同寬頻，」迪洛雷托話。「如果你要為你嘅港口供水，你就要有強大嘅道路系統。如果你要運送你嘅貨物同埋將你嘅貨物送入呢個國家，你就要有強大嘅港口。而且，如果冇道路去支援呢個情況，當［貨物］喺任何地方都出現唔到問題，噉會發生咩事？」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the afternoon of the 22nd of January of 2022, on my way back from the cafe, I met Sherie, wearing a red and black checkered long-sleeved shirt, as she was walking her pitbull. I asked her the name of her dog, which is "Sekari," supposedly Inuktitut. Sherie is part-Cree, part-French, part-Norwegian, etc., a "Heinz 57," we both agreed. Sherie has artificial vampiric fangs because she is a Goth.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 1 jyut6 22 hou6 ge3 haa6 zau3，ngo5 hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2 faan2 gan2 heoi3 ge3 lou6 soeng6，gin3 dou2 Sherie ，keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 hung4 hak1 gaak3 zai2 coeng4 zau6 saam1，keoi5 haang4 gan2 keoi5 zek3 pitbull 。ngo5 man6 keoi5 keoi5 zek3 gau2 ge3 meng2，hai6「sak1 kaa1 lei5」，jing1 goi1 hai6 ji1 nou5 hak1 dai3 tou4 dak6 jan4。Sherie hai6 bou6 fan6 hak1 lei5 jan4、bou6 fan6 faat3 gwok3 jan4、bou6 fan6 no4 wai1 jan4 dang2 dang2，hai6 jat1 go3「hoi2 jan1 ci4 57」，ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 tung4 ji3。 Sherie jau5 jan4 zou6 kap1 hyut3 gwai2 ngaa4 ci2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 go1 dak6 jan4。
text: 喺2022年1月22號嘅下晝，我喺咖啡館返緊去嘅路上，見到 Sherie ，佢着住件紅黑格仔長袖衫，佢行緊佢隻 pitbull 。我問佢佢隻狗嘅名，係「塞卡里」，應該係伊努克蒂圖特人。Sherie 係部分克里人、部分法國人、部分挪威人等等，係一個「海因茨 57」，我哋兩個都同意。 Sherie 有人造吸血鬼牙齒，因為佢係哥特人。
